topic: Data Science Project Workflow and Deployment
learningObjectives: Connect data preparation, modeling, evaluation, and deployment into one workflow.
Understand how APIs expose data science models to applications.
Identify the components required for a production-ready data science project.

activities.title: Map the End-to-End Workflow
activities.instruction: Explore how the major stages of a data science project connect.

content.concept: A complete data science workflow connects problem definition, data collection, preparation, analysis, modeling, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Define the question or business problem that needs to be solved.
Collect the relevant raw information required for analysis.
Clean, transform, and prepare data for analysis and modeling.
Explore distributions, relationships, patterns, and anomalies.
Train and configure a suitable statistical or machine learning model.
Measure model performance using appropriate validation methods and metrics.
Make the trained model available to an application or users.
Track system behavior, data changes, model performance, and operational issues.

activities.title: Build a Model API
activities.instruction: Assemble the components of a basic prediction API.

content.concept: A model API receives structured input, applies the required preprocessing, runs model inference, and returns a prediction response.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Sequence Project Deployment
activities.instruction: Arrange the major steps for deploying a data science application.

content.concept: Deployment involves packaging the application and model, configuring its environment, releasing the service, testing it, and monitoring its operation.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Validate Production Readiness
activities.instruction: Identify the components that support a reliable production data science system.

content.concept: Production systems require validated models, reliable application code, secure configuration, input validation, logging, monitoring, and maintainable deployment processes.
